definitions.explanation: A general term for items worn on the body, often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.japanese: {衣類|いるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
{衣類|いるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けて→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put your clothing away neatly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬物|ふゆもの}→冬物：27498_fuyumono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衣類|いるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{衣類|いるい}⟦{乾燥機|かんそうき}→乾燥機：04672_kansouki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧。
examples.english: Dry laundry in a clothes dryer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引っ越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{着|き}ない→着る：00541_kiru⟧{衣類|いるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧⟦ことにした→ことにする：10986_kotonisuru⟧。
examples.english: Before moving, I decided to gather up and throw away clothing I no longer wear.

notes:
{衣類|いるい} is a somewhat formal term for clothing, often used in signs, labels, and official contexts.

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (casual, everyday word for clothes)
- ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧ (Western-style clothes)
- ⟦{衣服|いふく}→衣服：01825_ifuku⟧ (formal, written: clothes/attire)
- {衣類|いるい} (formal, categorical: clothing/garments)

COMPOUNDS:
- {衣類|いるい}⟦{乾燥機|かんそうき}→乾燥機：04672_kansouki⟧ (clothes dryer)
- {衣類|いるい}⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧ (clothing storage)
- {衣類|いるい}⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧ (clothing case)

USAGE:
{衣類|いるい} often appears in contexts like laundry instructions, storage labels, and retail categorization rather than everyday conversation.
